meta.titulo: Used Porsche 912 for sale · Valentín Motors
meta.descripcion: Porsche 912, from 1965 to 1969, the 911 with the four-cylinder engine of the 356. Inspected on 111 points, with body and numbers verified and a twelve-month warranty.

parrafos: The 912 is the 911 body with the 1.6-litre four-cylinder engine of the 356 SC, giving 90 hp. Porsche created it so as not to lose 356 customers when the 911 went up in price, and in its first years it outsold the 911. Coupé and Targa, four- or five-speed gearbox.

It is lighter at the front than a 911 and for that reason drives with a precision that surprises. It is bought like a 911 F: for the body, the paperwork and the originality of the engine, which is easy to replace and hard to replace well.

secciones.titulo: What we check on a 912 before selling it
items: Corrosion: towers, sills, floors and windscreen base, as on any F-series 911.
Type 616 engine: originality, compression, Solex or Weber carburettors and electrical system.
Matching chassis, engine and gearbox numbers with the paperwork and the Porsche certificate.
Gearbox, disc brakes and condition of the steering.
Interior and period details: three-gauge instrumentation, upholstery and trim.

parrafos: Every Porsche 912 we sell goes through our 111-point inspection, leaves with a twelve-month or 10,000 km warranty on engine and gearbox, and its certified mileage is stated on the sales invoice. We have been Porsche specialists since 1979, with our own workshops in Barcelona and Madrid: the car you buy here has been on our lift before it reaches your hands.
If you have found the one you want elsewhere, we can also check it for you before you pay for it: pre-purchase inspection.
